requirements.missing: No supplied document describes a field-sampling protocol for estimating alfalfa yield prior to harvest with explicitly stated measured inputs (plant height, stem density, pod load, or cut-area weight) and output in t DM/ha. S10–S13/S15/S16 describe PEAQ, which estimates RFV/NDF (quality), not yield. S2 reports post-harvest mechanically measured yields in Mg ha⁻¹ but provides no pre-harvest sampling protocol. S17 correlates stem/plant density with relative yield but gives no deterministic conversion formula or cut-area weight protocol.

No supplied document contains a step-by-step procedure that deterministically converts measured field inputs (height, density, stem count, or quadrat weight) into an estimated yield in mass-per-area units. PEAQ documents (S10–S13, S15, S16) convert height + maturity stage to RFV/NDF—a quality index—not yield. S17 reports stem density as a correlate of relative yield with no explicit conversion equation or stated output units. S2 uses harvested plot mass but offers no pre-harvest estimation method.

While S10–S13, S15, S16 (UW/ISU Extension) and S2 (UMN, peer-reviewed) are university-affiliated, none are scoped to pre-harvest field measurement of yield. PEAQ estimates post-harvest quality (RFV/NDF). S2 measures post-harvest biomass. No source satisfies the scope constraint of pre-harvest yield estimation only.
